appStore.name: BirKare AI: Photo Studio
appStore.subtitle: AI Scenes, Portraits & Filters
appStore.promotionalText: Reimagine your photos in new scenes. Explore natural portraits, cinematic looks and creative filters while keeping control of your style.
appStore.description:
Tell a new story with your photo.

BirKare AI is an AI-assisted photo studio that helps you reimagine your own photos with scenes, portraits and visual styles.

CHOOSE YOUR SCENE
Explore different looks with a night stadium, city lights, a Mediterranean terrace, a mountain lake or a neon city atmosphere. Scene cards provide visual inspiration for the setting you want to create.

GIVE YOUR PORTRAIT A NEW TOUCH
Reimagine portraits with natural light, studio looks and cinematic tones. Use options that prioritize preserving facial and clothing details.

FIND YOUR STYLE WITH FILTERS
Try cartoon, watercolor, sketch, pop art, vintage, black and white, and more visual styles. Adjust the filter intensity to your preference.

EXPLORE AI TOOLS
Change the background, improve the lighting balance or expand the area around your photo with AI. Review your selection and image settings before generating.

CREATE FICTIONAL SCENES
Design creative scenes with fictional characters. Fictional images do not represent a real meeting, celebrity endorsement or actual event.

RETURN TO YOUR PROJECTS
Open completed generations again in Projects, save them to your device and share them.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
1. Take your own photo or choose an image you have permission to use.
2. Select a scene, filter or AI tool.
3. Review the image settings and displayed credit cost.
4. Start generation and review the result.

GOOD TO KNOW
AI generation requires an internet connection and an account. Generations may use credits; the required amount is shown before the operation. Results vary depending on the source photo and selected settings. Sample images do not guarantee results; facial similarity and image details may vary between generations.

Only use content you own or have the necessary permission to use. Do not present AI-generated images as evidence of a real event. BirKare AI is designed for users aged 18 and over.
